FN-VG32VLV-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 357
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Ed Oliver
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/02/2024
House Bill 357 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Volunteer Rescue Squad
Tuition Reimbursement Program by an undetermined amount dependent on any tuition paid for
attendance at any educational institutions that become eligible pursuant to this bill.
This bill could also increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Community College
System (ACCS) to administer the new provisions of this program as provided by this bill.
